findings.captureTiming: Capture all active printed text instances before field removal resets faces or detaches equipment. Replacement early-return and WasDestroyed gate suppress recall replacement triggers.
findings.controller: Captured EffectiveFieldControllerId precedes removal; return to owner graveyard does not change earned controller.
findings.sourceIdentity: Explicit captured SourceCardNo prevents borrowed face restoring to its physical card identity on stack.
findings.ceasedSource: Only known captured token factories and valid typed origins permit absent sources; public views bind exact context to typed authority.
findings.security: Public shape checks do not prove historical origin; original immutable command/event replay separately rejects coordinated origin removal and swapping.
findings.privacy: New public slot contains public captured card/equipment/unit bindings only, not private deck contents or choice ordering.
findings.compatibility: No old singular-payload fallback, old match migration, whole engine rewrite or DSL extension.
findings.remainingDirectEvidence: Simultaneous multi-source copied LastBreath case planned only after active original run terminal; no certification before actual test.
